text:
maria: FYI I woke up to pings from a few AEs — playbook 'welcome-check' fired twice for ~95 accounts around 03:05 UTC. Looks like webhook replay from our CRM.

lee: Thanks, I'm seeing repeated webhook deliveries in the connector logs. The legacy connector is acking late so upstream retries are replaying events.

divya: Quick audit:```sql
SELECT account_id, payload->>'event_id' AS event_id, count(*)
FROM playbook_events
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY account_id, payload->>'event_id'
HAVING count(*) > 1;
```

maria: Can we pause outbound nudges for affected accounts until we dedupe? Owners don't want duplicates.

lee: Short-term: I'll flip the scheduler -> max_runs_per_account = 1 and mute follow-ups for the 'welcome-check' playbook. Also I'll disable legacy connector retry behavior.

divya: For runner: add idempotency = payload.event_id when trigger.type = webhook. I can push a small patch and a migration to add idempotency_key column to queued_actions.

ops-bot: Created incident CS-2026-098  playbook-duplicate-alerts (severity: medium). Pagerduty notified.

maria: Please also queue a one-off backfill to recompute healthscore for the dozen accounts that had engagement recorded twice. We don't want renewal risk spikes.

lee: Plan: 1) disable connector retries (lee) 2) flip scheduler throttle (lee) 3) deploy runner dedupe (divya) 4) run cancel API for queued followups (maria) 5) healthscore backfill (divya).

divya: Deployed runner fix to prod, now honoring idempotency key and 12h TTL. Initial dedupe hits: 89.

maria: Cancelled queued follow-ups for the affected event_ids. DM'd owners with what happened and actions taken.

lee: Scheduler flag applied, no new duplicate runs in 20m.

divya: Backfill started, should finish in ~90 minutes for this cohort. Will post results.

maria: Postmortem action items: add unit test for webhook idempotency, add metrics for dedupe hits in console, update runbook to include connector retry flip steps. Closing once backfill and PM notified. :white_check_mark:
